confidence.CONFIDENT: We're seeing a pretty clear pattern...

profile_shape.BROAD: Your interests span several areas of English.
profile_shape.EXPLORATORY: You're still exploring - and your answers actually look like it. Nothing is dominating yet, so we're not going to pretend one path is ‘the answer.’

community.heading: Want to keep exploring?
community.body: Have a question about where your interests might lead? Email the Chair and tell us what caught your attention. You can also explore English advising and department resources below.
